wish.message: 😍 A {size_default} {color_default}{ticket} by {starter} fits your {emoji} alert list!
wish.instructions: You can only have one alert at a time.
wish.instruction_color: Choose the color of the nectar you're looking for. With special nectar you'll find large or elemental mushrooms.
wish.instruction_size: What size are you looking for? Choosing only larger mushrooms will stop notification for small and normal mushrooms.
wish.instruction_ticket: Do you have a ticket? If you're looking for only free slots, you won't get notified for ticket slots. If you choose free and with ticket, you get notification for all possible invites.
wish.instr_heart: {color_emoji} {color_noun} with fire, water, electric, crystal and poisonous mushrooms
wish.wish_blue: blue, purple, ice and water mushrooms
wish.wish_white: white, gray, crystal and poisonous mushrooms
wish.introduction: The Mushroom Alert notifies you as soon as a suitable mushroom fight is available. In the list of active mushroom fights with /active is a list of alerts others have set. After three days of inactivity, your alert will not be listed anymore. After 14 days of inactivity, you will not get notified for new mushrooms. You stay active by joining or starting a mushroom fight with the bot.
wish.noalarm: There are no mushroom alerts set, yet.

register.not_registered: You can only register yourself with me in a private chat. Start a chat with @{bot_name}, press 'START' and try the command /register again.
register.registered: Please use the command /profile to edit or complete your profile.

register.ask_fc: What is your friend code? This code is needed to get invited to mushroom battles in Pikmin Bloom. If you prefer to remain anonymous, enter "0".
register.fc_error: The friend code must be a 12 digit number. You entered: {friend_code}. Try again. Enter "0" if you prefer to remain anonymous.
register.ask_level: What is your level in Pikmin Bloom? To skip, enter "0".
register.newhint: You can use commands which are in the menu at the bottom. With /profile you can set your language and time zone as well as your player information. Try /active to see active mushroom offers. At the bottom there is a button for mushroom alerts. With mushroom alerts you will be informed when there is a mushroom you can join. You will be added to a chat group once you are a verified player. Please add Mello Yellow to your friends list to be verified. Their friend code is 499969789993 (click to copy)

timer.instructions: With the /timer command, you can see and delete your active timers. - If you answer to a mushroom message, you can activate a timer with the time remaining on that mushroom. - With /timer 2h30m "expedition" you start a timer for 2 hours and 30 minutes with the comment "expedition". - Comments are optional. The comment will be shown when the timer goes off.

start.description:
This bot can help you with Pikmin Bloom mushroom battles.

Head to the community support group if you have problems: https://t.me/PilzkampfForum
start.supergroup: ⚠️This is NO Super Group! This bot only works with Super Groups. Go to group settings and switch the type to "public" and save the change. Optionally can switch it back to private afterwards. Additionally, the bot must have admin priviledges. It is recommended to use the standard admin priviledges. At least the bot needs to create invite links and delete messages.
